stem: Imagine you discover that someone you trusted has been telling a different version of your relationship to other people.

options.label: A
options.text: That they could look at me differently after hearing it.

options.label: B
options.text: That I misjudged the person completely.

options.label: C
options.text: That they felt they couldn't tell me what they really thought.

options.label: D
options.text: That something I believed was real may never have been real.

stem: You are given the opportunity to start an entirely new life, but nobody from your current life can come with you.

options.label: A
options.text: Relief.

options.label: B
options.text: Curiosity.

options.label: C
options.text: Fear of what I would lose.

options.label: D
options.text: Excitement mixed with sadness.

stem: Someone criticizes a part of your personality that you secretly know is true.

options.label: A
options.text: I immediately want to defend myself.

options.label: B
options.text: I become quiet and think about it later.

options.label: C
options.text: I wonder how they discovered that about me.

options.label: D
options.text: I feel exposed more than offended.

stem: You could know one absolute truth about your life, but knowing it would remove all uncertainty. Would you choose to know?

options.label: A
options.text: Yes. I would rather know than wonder.

options.label: B
options.text: No. Some things are better discovered naturally.

options.label: C
options.text: Only if I could change the outcome.

options.label: D
options.text: I'd want to know, but I'm not sure I'd want to believe it.

stem: Think of the last time you felt completely misunderstood. What did you want most from the other person?

options.label: A
options.text: For them to listen without correcting me.

options.label: B
options.text: For them to understand why I reacted the way I did.

options.label: C
options.text: For them to recognize that I wasn't as unaffected as I appeared.

options.label: D
options.text: For them to simply trust that I knew what I was doing.

stem: You walk into a room where everyone seems to know something you don't.

options.label: A
options.text: Watch everyone before saying anything.

options.label: B
options.text: Ask directly what is happening.

options.label: C
options.text: Pretend I haven't noticed.

options.label: D
options.text: Try to work it out myself.

stem: If someone you love repeatedly makes the same mistake, eventually you:

options.label: A
options.text: Keep helping them.

options.label: B
options.text: Tell them the truth even if it hurts.

options.label: C
options.text: Step back and let them experience the consequences.

options.label: D
options.text: Try to understand what keeps pulling them back into it.

stem: Which would be harder for you to accept?

options.label: A
options.text: Being forgotten.

options.label: B
options.text: Being replaced.

options.label: C
options.text: Being controlled.

options.label: D
options.text: Discovering that you had been wrong about yourself.

stem: You suddenly realize that the life you've built no longer feels like yours.

options.label: A
options.text: Stay until I understand exactly what changed.

options.label: B
options.text: Leave, even without knowing what comes next.

options.label: C
options.text: Quietly start building another possibility.

options.label: D
options.text: Try to transform the life I already have.

stem: Someone offers you a position of enormous influence, but nobody would ever know that you were the person behind the decisions.

options.label: A
options.text: Yes. Influence matters more than recognition.

options.label: B
options.text: No. If I carry the responsibility, I want accountability too.

options.label: C
options.text: Maybe. It depends on what I could accomplish.

options.label: D
options.text: I'd rather influence people without controlling them.

stem: When someone becomes emotionally distant from you, your first instinct is usually:

options.label: A
options.text: Give them space.

options.label: B
options.text: Find out what changed.

options.label: C
options.text: Become distant myself.

options.label: D
options.text: Wonder whether I did something wrong.

stem: You have to choose between a peaceful life that never surprises you and a difficult life that could completely transform you.

options.label: A
options.text: Peace.

options.label: B
options.text: Transformation.

options.label: C
options.text: I'd want a balance.

options.label: D
options.text: I'd choose the difficult path if it felt meaningful.

stem: Someone gives you an apology, but you can tell they haven't really changed.

options.label: A
options.text: The apology still matters.

options.label: B
options.text: Actions matter more than words.

options.label: C
options.text: I would forgive them but change my relationship with them.

options.label: D
options.text: I'd want to understand why they haven't changed.

stem: Which thought would stay with you longer?

options.label: A
options.text: What if I had stayed?

options.label: B
options.text: What if I had left sooner?

options.label: C
options.text: What if I had trusted myself?

options.label: D
options.text: What if I had been wrong?

stem: You are told that someone has formed a completely false opinion of you.

options.label: A
options.text: Correct them.

options.label: B
options.text: Let them think whatever they want.

options.label: C
options.text: Try to understand why they see me that way.

options.label: D
options.text: It would bother me, even if I didn't show it.

stem: You are alone in a place where nobody knows who you are.

options.label: A
options.text: Freedom.

options.label: B
options.text: Vulnerability.

options.label: C
options.text: Possibility.

options.label: D
options.text: Disconnection.

stem: If you could remove one recurring pattern from your life, which would you choose?

options.label: A
options.text: Overthinking.

options.label: B
options.text: Caring too much about people who don't reciprocate.

options.label: C
options.text: Holding on longer than I should.

options.label: D
options.text: Needing to do everything myself.

stem: You are given a choice between being deeply understood by one person or admired by thousands.

options.label: A
options.text: Understood by one.

options.label: B
options.text: Admired by thousands.

options.label: C
options.text: Neither — I'd rather remain completely free.

options.label: D
options.text: I'd choose the one that lasts longer.

stem: Someone tells you a truth about yourself that you weren't ready to hear.

options.label: A
options.text: Resistance.

options.label: B
options.text: Curiosity.

options.label: C
options.text: Silence.

options.label: D
options.text: A strange feeling that they may be right.

stem: When you imagine your future self, what matters most?

options.label: A
options.text: That I am free.

options.label: B
options.text: That I am respected.

options.label: C
options.text: That I am surrounded by people I love.

options.label: D
options.text: That I became someone I couldn't have imagined before.

stem: Achieving your biggest goal would require becoming a person you don't recognize.

options.label: A
options.text: Change the goal.

options.label: B
options.text: Change myself.

options.label: C
options.text: Find another route.

options.label: D
options.text: Question whether I ever truly wanted the goal.

stem: Someone walks away from your life without giving you an explanation.

options.label: A
options.text: Not knowing why.

options.label: B
options.text: Knowing I couldn't stop it.

options.label: C
options.text: Wondering whether I mattered to them.

options.label: D
options.text: Having no opportunity to say what I needed to say.

stem: When you're under extreme pressure, what part of you becomes strongest?

options.label: A
options.text: My ability to think.

options.label: B
options.text: My ability to endure.

options.label: C
options.text: My ability to take control.

options.label: D
options.text: My ability to disappear emotionally.

stem: You have one chance to ask your future self a question.

options.label: A
options.text: Did we make the right decisions?

options.label: B
options.text: Did we become happy?

options.label: C
options.text: Did we become who we wanted to be?

options.label: D
options.text: Who did we lose along the way?

stem: Imagine that nobody could ever judge you again. What would change first?

options.label: A
options.text: The way I express myself.

options.label: B
options.text: The choices I make.

options.label: C
options.text: The people I allow close to me.

options.label: D
options.text: Probably nothing — I already live according to myself.

stem: You have to choose one: being right but alone, or being wrong but surrounded by people you love.

options.label: A
options.text: Right but alone.

options.label: B
options.text: With the people I love.

options.label: C
options.text: Neither — I'd find another solution.

options.label: D
options.text: It depends on what I'm wrong about.

stem: You realize someone close to you needs something from you that they have never asked for directly. What do you do?

options.label: A
options.text: Wait until they say it.

options.label: B
options.text: Offer help without making them explain.

options.label: C
options.text: Ask them what they actually need.

options.label: D
options.text: Notice it, but decide not to interfere.

stem: You are given a choice between knowing exactly how people see you and never knowing what they think of you.

options.label: A
options.text: I would want to know.

options.label: B
options.text: I would rather remain unaware.

options.label: C
options.text: I'd want to know only about the people closest to me.

options.label: D
options.text: I'd rather judge myself by my own standards.

stem: You are standing at the end of your life and looking back at yourself today. What would you hope that person had understood?

options.label: A
options.text: You were allowed to choose yourself.

options.label: B
options.text: The people you loved were never a weakness.

options.label: C
options.text: You knew more than you thought you did.

options.label: D
options.text: You were capable of becoming someone entirely different.
